name: MIG_WM_GLDFUNDINGENGINE20080714_FUNDINGENGINEWRAPPER
description: Migrated from webMethods IS service GLDFundingEngine/Wrappers/fundingEngineWrapper (package: gldfundingengine20080714). This recipe acts as a SOAP wrapper for the GLD Funding Engine. It receives an inbound SOAP request, extracts the SOAP body from the envelope (equivalent to pub.soap.utils:getBody), converts the extracted XML body node into a document/string representation (equivalent to pub.xml:xmlNodeToDocument), and then forwards the structured payload to the downstream Funding Engine service for processing. The recipe exposes a callable HTTP POST endpoint that accepts a SOAP request payload as a JSON-serialised string. GAPS: (1) The native IS services pub.soap.utils:getBody and pub.xml:xmlNodeToDocument have no direct Workato equivalents and are represented as HTTP POST placeholders — an SME must provide the actual endpoint URLs or replace these steps with appropriate Workato XML/string manipulation. (2) Full SOAP envelope parsing and XML-to-document conversion logic must be implemented externally or via a custom connector. (3) The internal pipeline variable mappings (soapRequestData → soapData → body) are approximated via data pills but require manual wiring in the Workato GUI.
